read.thesis: Q4 divestiture-adjusted operational growth only 2% with generics flat and FY25 Adjusted EBITDA down 6%; 2026 guide ($4.15–4.45B) rests on $600–700M restructuring savings and a Nashik plant shut until April.

triggers.label: Nashik plant shut until April 2026
triggers.quote: Manufacturing at the facility has been temporarily suspended and the Company currently expects to resume operations beginning in April 2026.

triggers.label: Restructuring: $700–850M charges, $600–700M savings
triggers.quote: management believes the potential savings related to these committed restructuring activities will be between $600 million and $700 million once fully implemented

triggers.label: Generics net sales flat in Q4
triggers.quote: Generics net sales were impacted by expected competition on certain products in North America

triggers.label: Japan government price regulation hit
triggers.quote: negative impacts from government price regulations in Japan

guidance.quote: U.S. GAAP net cash provided by operating activities for 2026 is estimated to be between $1.7 billion and $2.0 billion
The Company expects to deliver $450 million to $550 million in new product revenues in 2026.
the Company expects to incur total pre-tax charges ranging between $700 million and $850 million

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA / Adjusted EPS / revenue ranges (Nov 6, 2025)
prior_guidance_check.quote: Meets or Exceeds 2025 Financial Guidance Across All Key Metrics
U.S. GAAP net cash provided by operating activities for 2025 was $2.3 billion

red_flags.label: Nashik plant fire and shutdown until April 2026
red_flags.quote: a fire occurred in a service area at the Company's oral solid dose manufacturing facility in Nashik, India.

red_flags.label: Q4 loss from plant remediation and contract terminations
red_flags.quote: driven by contractual termination costs, remediation costs, and incremental manufacturing variances at plants slated for sale or closure
